 Game Of Thrones Officially Replaces Daenerys Targaryen In Dragonfire 
 From Screen Rant (Written by James Lynch) on November 11, 2026 | OpenCritic 
 Daenerys Targaryen's story arc in Game of Thrones really did have the potential to be an all-timer, and while the books haven't covered all that ground yet, the show left most very disappointed with how it handled her grand conclusion. Her journey to madness always made sense, given the history of her family, but the sudden about turn proved to be extremely jarring for those who watched it.
 That said, she's still an iconic character in the fantasy genre as a whole, and Emilia Clarke's performance is a big part of that, even if it didn't end in the way many of us hoped. Now, a newer Game of Thrones adaptation is making some major next moves, but the developer has chosen to focus on one of her ancestors in the latest update.
 In case you haven't been introduced to it yet, Game of Thrones: Dragonfire is a 4X strategy role-playing game that's currently available as an Android exclusive. It's good fun, on the whole, and Warner Bros. Games have confirmed that the next update is set to star Rhaenyra Targaryen and a whole host of other characters from the more recent House of the Dragon .
